name: Uchuu Youhei Alicia ~Igyou no Shokushu Seibutsu ni Tanetsuke Sarete~
original_name: 宇宙傭兵アリシア～異形の触手生物に種付けされて～
source:
Universal Century......
An era where humanity traverses the stars and communicates with alien lifeforms on a day to day basis. Among these star farers is Alicia, a space mercenary. She has been given a special mission...

To rescue the president's daughter from a slave colony!

She makes her way to save her but with Mia being taken hostage, she cannot put up any resistance and is captured. Awaiting here in the slave colony, the life of a guinea pig...

It turns out that Alicia's genetic material is superb and she is thus forced to copulate with various alien lifeforms. Forced to endure the humiliation of being inseminated by and giving birth to disgusting monstrous creatures. Can Alicia bear her ordeal and rescue Mia safely or...?
